branchName.instructions: Use <type>/<short-kebab-case-description> in English. Choose type from feat, fix, docs, chore, ci, refactor, or test.

commitMessage.instructions: Use Conventional Commits with a scope: <type>(<scope>): <short description>. Write the description in English. Use a scope that describes the changed component, such as adapter, upstream, release, or docs.

pullRequest.instructions: Write the title and body in English. Start with a Summary and include a Test plan section. List only checks actually performed and their results; mark unperformed checks as Not run. Describe configuration, persistent-data, or image-publication impact when relevant. Never include API keys, credentials, or real vehicle locations. Pushing changes or opening a PR does not authorize merging. Leave the PR open and do not enable auto-merge unless the user explicitly requests merging this specific PR or branch.
